description: Synthetic generic_flat_ocr payload as written by a local_command OCR provider (RETAIN_OCR_RAW_PAYLOAD_JSON). Two bilingual (English/Chinese) technical-note pages in 2x pixel coordinates (1190x1684) for A4 595x842 pt pages. Covers title, headings, abstracts, multi-line body with explicit lines/spans, inline formula, figure/table with captions, footnote, display formula, code, references, header/footer/page number. All bboxes are positive-area and nested (span in line in block in page).
tricky_points: The payload is in pixels (2x) but page.unit must be 'pt' (or omitted): the validator rejects 'px' ('expected pt'). Page 1 omits unit, page 2 sets 'pt'; both are pixel coordinates in reality, so the scale 0.5 must come from the normalize step using the PDF page size, not from unit.

The adapter has NO reading-order support: block order = array index, and a raw block-level 'reading_order' is ignored (the adapter does not copy it). continuation_hint.reading_order is only normalised and carried through (block 8 on page 1 has role=single, scope=intra_page, reading_order=8). Therefore page 2 is NOT shuffled: array order = reading order.

Titles, captions, footnotes, references, headers/footers/page numbers are all translate=false; only body, abstract and heading sub_types are translated. Table captions and figure captions are plain type=text blocks with sub_type table_caption/figure_caption (layout_role=caption); structure_role is not set by the adapter (_structure_role returns '') and is later filled in by classification (observed 'metadata').
Front-matter author line is sub_type body sitting between a title and a heading; the adapter downgrades it to metadata with translate=false.

lines/segments are passed through verbatim: top-level segments duplicate the line spans (same bboxes) and are scaled independently; lines on the Chinese blocks omit bbox_precision on purpose to check nothing defaults it, other lines carry provider_layout.
Only the image block (via metadata.asset_key/asset_url) gets an asset; the table block has none even though it is a non-text block.

Inline formula spans use type inline_formula with raw_type inline_equation; the display formula uses type formula with raw_type display_formula; their text is LaTeX in $...$ inline and bare LaTeX for display.
Table lines are one per row with one span per cell (raw_type table_cell); block text is rows joined by newline with ' | ' between cells.
Block text of CJK paragraphs is the line texts joined with '' while English lines are joined with a single space.
Unit-less fields: top-level fields like page 'page' are optional; 'score' on spans is 0.93-0.97.
